note: No shipment evidence found either way — this is an evidence gap, not a negative finding. ImportKey's India pages are paywalled shells that render no rows without a trial login, so the absence of visible records does not prove the company has no exports. Declared HS 854239 (electronic integrated circuits/microassemblies) is consistent with the claimed IT/electronics industry, but HS consistency is not shipment proof. Claimed proprietor 'MAHESH KANJIBHAI KATIRA' could not be corroborated against any public record in this session; PAN, CIN and state are null — not public in the sources reachable. Per Rule 5, the company's own name/catalogue presence is NOT treated as evidence of supply: status is 'unknown' rather than 'declared_only' only because no company website or catalogue was even reachable to record a declaration. Recommend re-running with a working search backend and a Volza/Eximpedia trial account before any verdict; do not read this as 'следов поставок не найдено' — the traces were simply not queryable.
